thread:
Sylvie: Follow-up from today's DR tabletop. We keep hitting three repeating problems during rehearsals: route-table drift after automated promotions, eu backups lagging ~10-20m, and noisy healthchecks. Need owners, short timelines, and a tracking cadence.
Omar: I can take route drift. Suspect a race between promotion job and peer reconciler. Plan: add publish-idempotency and make reconcile a post-step. Target: 6 business days for a staging patch + canary.
Keiko: I'll own runbook updates and the game-day dry-run logistics. Propose Sat 05/02 03:30 PT for minimal impact. Will add pre-flight checklist and a 30m retro.
Jamal: I'll own backup replication & quick-restore smoke-tests. Proposal: nightly schema-only restore to a small instance with restore_time metric and alert on lag >8m twice in 24h. ETA: 4 working days.
Priya: I'll coordinate customer comms and request product to mute customer-facing alerts for the window. Also can help tag support rotation.
ops-bot: Created task 9801 "route-publish-idempotency" assigned to @Omar due in 6d. Created task 9802 "nightly-schema-restore" assigned to @Jamal due in 4d. Created task 9803 "dry-run-scheduling" assigned to @Keiko scheduled 05/02.
Omar: Quick checklist for routing fix: 1) add publish token 2) publish routes 3) run reconcile 4) assert route-diff == 0 after 90s 5) canary at 0.5% then ramp. Will open PR under ff/route-stability-2026.
Jamal: Smoke-restore snippet I'll use: ```bash
SNAP=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP
# attach to t3.small, run app basic checks, emit restore_time metric
```
Keiko: Runbook additions: KMS cross-region check, peering & route sanity, reserve minimal infra, contact matrix, mute channel play. I'll push to confluence and tag infra for review.
Priya: For customer note: short transparent summary + rollback assurances. I'll draft and share for review before the dry-run.
Omar: Canary policy: start 0.5% traffic; circuit-break to origin if region error >2% for 3m. Keep manual gate for >5%.
Jamal: Alerting: replication lag >8m twice in 24h -> escalate to infra pager. Dashboard will show 95/99p and restore_time histogram.
Keiko: I'll schedule dry-run invite and block infra for 2 hours including a 30m retro. Will confirm capacity and update runbook by EOD Thursday.
Sylvie: Ownership recap: Omar -> route publish fix + canary (6d); Jamal -> nightly schema restores + dashboard (4d); Keiko -> runbook + dry-run (scheduled 05/02 03:30 PT); Priya -> comms + alert mute. Ops-bot -> weekly recurring failover-patterns audit.
ops-bot: Recurring task 9850 created: "weekly-failover-patterns-audit" assigned to oncall-rotation first run 05/06.
Omar: Will add an automated verification probe post-change to hit a canary endpoint and assert E2E connectivity.
Jamal: I'll push pipeline logs to #incidents with pass/fail and timings after first run.
Priya: Confirmed on comms. I'll prepare customer-facing template and internal postmortem update.
Sylvie: Please respond here to confirm owners/timelines by EOD. I'll update the postmortem action tracker and mark items P0/P1. Thanks.
Omar: Confirmed.
Jamal: Confirmed, starting pipeline tomorrow.
Keiko: Confirmed, booking invite now.
Priya: Confirmed.
